definitions.gloss: later on; afterward; in a little while
definitions.explanation: A polite way to say 'later.' Used in business and formal contexts to indicate something will happen at a later time, typically within the same day.

examples.japanese: {後程|のちほど}ご⟦{連絡|れんらく}します→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧。
⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{後程|のちほど}お⟦{送|おく}り→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: I will send you the materials later.

examples.japanese: ⟦{詳|くわ}しい→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{後程|のちほど}{改|あらた}めてご⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦させて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いただきます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: I will explain the details properly at a later time.

notes:
A polite, somewhat formal adverb meaning 'later.' Very common in business Japanese, customer service, and formal spoken contexts. Typically implies the action will take place relatively soon — within hours rather than days.

REGISTER:
More formal than ⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧, which is the casual equivalent. {後程|のちほど} is standard in business emails, phone calls, and formal speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {後程|のちほど}ご⟦{連絡|れんらく}します→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧: I'll contact you later
- {後程|のちほど}お⟦{送|おく}り→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧: I'll send it later
- {後程|のちほど}{改|あらた}めて: again at a later time (even more formal)
- {後程|のちほど}お{伺|うかが}い⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧: I'll visit later (humble)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: later — casual, everyday equivalent
- ⟦{後日|ごじつ}→後日：12510_gojitsu⟧: at a later date — implies a different day, more formal
- {改|あらた}めて: again, on another occasion — focuses on doing something over properly
